citation.authors: Greene CA, Hampton G, Jaworski J, Shuey MM et al

record.population: 7,837 keloid cases and 1,593,009 controls across continental ancestry groups
record.finding: 26 genetic loci were found, 12 replicated. Estimated heritability was 6% in European, 21% in East Asian and 34% in African ancestry analyses. The authors state keloids are more likely in darker-skinned people of African and Asian descent than in Europeans.
